name: Hardest Math questions - 1
description: SAT Math · 1 module × 22 questions. The 22 most approachable problems from "SAT MATH 100 Hard & Challenging Questions by Akbarjon Kodirov", reproduced as text. 11 multiple-choice and 11 student-produced responses.

questions.question: A circle in the xy-plane has its center at (-7, 3) and has a radius of 9. An equation of this circle is x² + y² + ax + by + c = 0, where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of c?

-12(5x - 3)² + 6(5x - 4)²

The given expression can be rewritten as (a/6)x² + (b/6)x + (c/6), where a, b, and c are constants. What is the value of a + b + c?

The composition of an animal is defined as the muscles, bones, and fat of the animal. A scientist studied the composition of one young swamp buffalo and determined the buffalo had 133 kilograms of muscle, which made up approximately 65.9% of its composition. Of the remaining composition of this buffalo, approximately 46.2% was bone, and the remainder was fat. Based on these approximations, to the nearest tenth, how many kilograms of this buffalo's composition was bone?

In the xy-plane, a circle has center D with coordinates (m, 16), where m is a constant. Points E and F lie on the circle. Point E lies on the circle and has coordinates (m + 4√10, 34) and point F has coordinates (n, 16), where n is a constant greater than m. What is the area, in square units, of triangle DEF?

y = -3x² - 34
y = qx - 31

In the given system of equations, q is a positive constant. The graphs of the equations in the given system intersect at exactly one point, (x, y), in the xy-plane. What is the value of x?

In a set of four consecutive odd integers, where the integers are ordered from least to greatest, the first integer is represented by x. The product of 18 and the fourth odd integer is at most 22 less than the sum of the first and third odd integers. Which inequality represents this situation?
The expression kx represents the result of decreasing a positive force, x, acting on an object by 0.34%. What is the value of k?

ax + by = 68
2ax + 6y = 48

In the given system of equations, a and b are constants. The graphs of these equations intersect at the point (x, 4). What is the value of b?

8x² + 112px + 8y² - 64py = -448p²

In the xy-plane, the graph of the given equation is a circle. The length of the radius of the circle is np, where n and p are positive constants. What is the value of n?

A right square pyramid has a total surface area of 28,160 square inches, and the combined surface area of the four lateral faces of this pyramid is 16,060 square inches. What is the height, in inches, of this pyramid?

A quadratic function models the height, in feet, of an object above the ground in terms of the time, in seconds, after the object is launched off an elevated surface. The model indicates the object has an initial height of 2 feet above the ground and reaches its maximum height of 258 feet above the ground 4 seconds after being launched. Based on the model, what is the height, in feet, of the object above the ground 5 seconds after being launched?

0 = (x - k)(7x + t) - (x - k)

In the given equation, k and t are positive constants. A solution to the equation is -22/7. What is the value of t?

The figure shown consists of a rectangle and a semicircle, where the length of WX is 20 units and the length of WZ is 5 units. The diameter of the semicircle is WX. Which of the following expressions represents the area, in square units, of the figure?

A right square pyramid has a height of 11 centimeters (cm). A second right square pyramid has a height of 22 centimeters. The area of the bases of each of the two pyramids is 100 cm². Which of the following is closest to the difference in the surface area of the second pyramid and the surface area of the first pyramid, in cm²?

The expression 6x⁴ + 17x² + 7 can be rewritten as (3x² + a)(2x² + b), where a and b are positive integers, or as (3x² + c)(2x² + d), where c and d are positive nonintegers. What is the value of a + c?

A rectangular region of land is divided into 88 square lots of equal area A, in square units. The length of the region is 5.5 times the width of the region. If the length of the region is x√A units, what is the value of x?

Right rectangular prism X is similar to right rectangular prism Y. The surface area of right rectangular prism X is 58 square centimeters (cm²), and the surface area of right rectangular prism Y is 1,450 cm². The volume of right rectangular prism Y is 1,500 cubic centimeters (cm³). What is the sum of the volumes, in cm³, of right rectangular prism X and right rectangular prism Y?
For the equation x(14x + 15) + c = 9, one possible solution is (-15 + √113)/28. What is the value of c?
A rectangular region is divided into 40 equal squares. The area of each square is R, the length of the rectangular region is 1.6 times its width, and the width is x√R. What is the value of x?
A right square pyramid has a surface area of 100 + 20√146 square inches, which includes a base area of 100 square inches. What is the height, in inches, of this pyramid?

A hollow steel pipe is in the shape of a right circular cylinder. The steel pipe has an outside diameter of 48 inches, a wall thickness of ⅝ inches, and a height of 144 inches. Which of the following is closest to the volume, in cubic inches, of the wall of this steel pipe?

The scatterplot for data set A consists of the weights y, in pounds, of a Labrador retriever puppy at various ages x, in months. The equation of a line of best fit for the relationship in data set A can be written as y = -5.0 + 8.7x, where 2 ≤ x ≤ 6. The puppy was weighed again at 9 months old and weighed 52 pounds. Data set B consists of all the data points in data set A as well as the data point (9, 52). The equation of a line of best fit for data set B can be written as y = r + sx, where r and s are constants and 2 ≤ x ≤ 9. Assuming the equations of the lines of best fit are calculated in the same way, which of the following is the best estimate for the value of s?
